SELECT pa.shop_id AS shopId, pa.user_id AS userId, s.shop_name AS shopName, u.nickname AS nickname, u.phone AS phone, IFNULL(pa.base_points, 0) AS basePoints, IFNULL(pa.bonus_points, 0) AS bonusPoints, IFNULL(pa.base_points, 0) + IFNULL(pa.bonus_points, 0) AS remainingPoints, IFNULL(pa.total_used_points, 0) AS totalUsedPoints, pa.update_time AS updateTime FROM mobi_points_account pa INNER JOIN mobi_user u ON u.user_id = pa.user_id INNER JOIN mobi_shop s ON s.id = pa.shop_id
AND pa.shop_id = #{query.shopId}
AND pa.user_id = #{query.userId}
AND s.shop_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.shopName}, '%')
AND ( u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.nickname}, '%')
AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.phone}, '%')
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
remainingPoints ASC, pa.update_time DESC
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
pa.total_used_points DESC, pa.update_time DESC
ORDER BY

ORDER BY
